messages.subject: reading large gt3x files
parts:
Hi, I run into memory issues when loading large gt3x file (~800mb , 100Hz) using read.gt3x, the unzipped data is around 4GB, but I have a 16GB RAM that can be used by R. 
I know for csv we can read by chunk to avoid memory issue, but wonder if there is any solution with gt3x file? 
Thanks

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] reading large gt3x files
parts:
Hi Ruopeng,

GGIR reads all file formats, including gt3x, in chunks of approximately 1 day of data.
However, it keeps aggregates of each day in memory until the whole file is processed. If files are very big then that can be too much memory. To address this we have argument chunksize, which is a ratio relative to the default chunksize. Setting it to for example 0.3 should ease processing the data.

If that does not address the issue then try do.parallel = FALSE when processing GGIR part 1. If even that does not fix the problem then please report back.

Best,

Vincent
